anomalies.description: A vehicle ahead veers sharply left and collides with a roadside embankment or barrier, resulting in a large dust cloud and visible structural deformation of the vehicle and terrain.

A large, sudden dust and debris cloud erupts from a structure on the left, consistent with a near-instantaneous blast event; the structure appears to disintegrate outward in frame f0 and is already heavily obscured by the expanding dust plume in f1.

A vehicle (likely military) is seen approaching a damaged embankment/road barrier; by f9 (12.5 s), it is at the crest, and in f10 (13.0 s) it appears to impact or go over the edge, with visible disturbance and dust indicating a crash or rollover.

A large-scale structural collapse and dust cloud consistent with a controlled demolition or explosive breaching of a concrete/earth structure; massive debris ejection and rapid dust plume expansion occur from frame f0 to f9.
